checks: Clicking a real canvas object prepares the existing safe target and opens editing without deleting tools
Raw title and notes buffers survive target changes; staging one cannot silently drop another pending input
Two-target title/notes edits support atomic whole-operation undo/redo and copy delivery
Copy collision preserves all changes; a new multi-operation copy reopens correctly while the original is untouched
Source save cancellation never writes or clears changes
Reload cancellation and native read failure retain the exact prior page, input and staged changes
During validation, inputs and navigation controls are locked; isolated and transaction previews bind to the same text
Saving locks related input and route changes, then reads back before clearing the draft
A completed write followed by read failure is reported honestly and preserves the draft and old page
A source conflict remains globally visible even with tools closed and never overwrites the peer update
Write failure keeps the exact draft; a deliberate retry completes without weakening checks
Ctrl+S confirms exactly once and cannot leak to the hidden library text-save listener
Unapplied input is protected on ordinary leave and same-path external-read-only transitions
A stale preview from another library cannot stage or enable saving in the new document context
Six light/dark styles and 760/480/360px layouts keep controls, normal motion and changes without page overflow
External presentations retain the existing read-only boundary and no write controls
